cases.name: lock-int
cases.cs: int x=5; lock(new object()){x=7;} return x;

cases.name: lock-buffer
cases.cs: int x=0; lock(new object()){x=42;} return x;

cases.name: lock-compound
cases.body:
var x=0
lock(let r=&mut x)
{
*r=3
*r+=1
}
return x
cases.cs: int x=0; lock(new object()){x=3; x+=1;} return x;

cases.name: lock-release
cases.body:
var x=1
lock(let r=&mut x)
{
*r=2
}
let s=&mut x
*s=5
return x
cases.cs: int x=1; lock(new object()){x=2;} x=5; return x;

cases.name: lock-return
cases.cs: int x=4; lock(new object()){return x+1;} return 0;

cases.name: lock-break
cases.cs: int total=0; while(true){lock(new object()){total=3; break;}} return total;

cases.name: lock-nested-disjoint
cases.cs: int x=0,y=0; lock(new object()){lock(new object()){x=1;y=2;}} return x*10+y;

cases.name: lock-block-body
cases.cs: int x=1; lock(new object()){if(true){x*=4;}} return x;
